verdict.rationale: Devin's own MCP scheduling tooling documents 'notification preferences' for scheduled sessions, so the product has a first-party notification setting. Nothing describes what triggers notifications, such as task completion or Devin needing input, or which channels deliver them. Slack/Teams tagging is evidenced only as a way to start sessions. Missing for 10: documented completion notifications, documented needs-input alerts, delivery channel details, coverage for non-scheduled sessions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get notified when an agent completes a task or needs my input

citations.quote: Supports cron expressions for recurring schedules, one-time scheduling, notification preferences, and agent selection
